hero.title: SignTrustMap
hero.subtitle: AI + Community platform for building a reliable and trusted traffic sign database.
hero.marquee_label: Compatible with and powered by leading AI models & dev tools

stats.s1_desc: YOLO12 vision model combined with CLIP accurately classifies traffic signs per QCVN 41:2019 standards.
stats.s2_desc: Automatically filters reverse direction signs, alerting drivers only to signage relevant to their current lane.
stats.s3_desc: Every traffic sign undergoes peer-review verification and consensus before official map publication.

topo.title: From field camera to trusted navigation map
topo.subtitle: A comprehensive pipeline solving the data latency and constant change of traffic signs in Vietnam.

cards.c1_body: Drivers and contributors record trip footage paired with accurate GPS telemetry on real-world routes.
cards.c2_body: Automated pipeline detects sign candidate regions, crops optimal frames, and maps visual vectors.
cards.c3_body: Reviewers quickly validate data, pushing trusted road signage into the live direction-aware map.

map_preview.title: Search & classify signs by QCVN 41 standard
map_preview.subtitle: Access the interactive spatial map with search, cluster filtering, revalidation history, and field evidence images.
map_preview.feature_1: 5 sign groups: Prohibition (P), Mandatory (R), Warning (W), Informational (I), Supplementary (S)
map_preview.feature_3: View Trust Score and community data sources

mobile_cta.title: Survey the field, earn Credit rewards
mobile_cta.subtitle: Use the SignTrustMap app to record trips (Video + GPX) or capture new signs. Earn transparent credit rewards when your contributions pass community review.
mobile_cta.badge_2_desc: Sign alerts matching your travel direction
mobile_cta.badge_3_desc: Receive tasks to refresh outdated signs
